caption: The drawing depicts a single, pouch-like object rendered in muted tones of grey and blue. The object has an overall vertical, elongated oval shape, with a scalloped, ribbed edge at the top that forms a decorative border. Below the ribbed section, the body of the pouch is decorated with a repeating pattern of stylized blue leaves or floral motifs set against a grey background. Near the bottom, the pouch tapers to a rounded tip and the edge is finished with a series of looped details that form an open, lace-like border. The pouch appears to be made of a beaded or knitted fabric, and the entire object is depicted on a plain, pale background. The artist’s name, “Frank E. Barnes,” is inscribed in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Bag
